Dam Mast Qalandar Must Must
Dam Mast Qalandar Must Must
verses.en:
With every breath I recite the name of Qalandar as if in a trance
With every breath I recite the name of Qalandar as if in a trance

verses.ar:
Ik Vird Hai Dam Dam Ali Ali
Sakhi Laal Qalandar Must Must
Jhoole Laal Qalandar Must Must
verses.en:
My practice is to recite the name of Ali with every breath
I utter the great Qalandar's name as if in a trance
I say Jhulelal as if in a trance

verses.ar:
Akhi Ja Malanga Tu Ali Ali Ali Akhi Ja Malanga
Akhi Ja Malanga Sajea Pe Mun Lain Gay
Aj Ne Te Kal Saray Ali Ali Kain Gay
verses.en:
Keep reciting the name of Ali O devotee!
Keep reciting for your utterance will be accepted eventually O devotee!
If not today, then tomorrow everyone will follow you in reciting his name O devotee!

Dam Mast Qalandar Must Must
verses.en:
With every breath I recite the name of Qalandar as if in a trance
With every breath I recite the name of Qalandar as if in a trance

verses.ar:
Rab Ne Kinne Shaan Banaye
Be Karma Te Karm Kamaye
Jehda Vi Tere Dar Te Aaye O Na Kadhi Vi Khaali Jaye
verses.en:
Such favour God has bestowed upon you
So that you may bestow it on the wretched
Whosoever visits your door, never does he return empty handed

verses.ar:
Shana Uchiyaan Terian Peera
Hovan Door Haneriyaan Peera
Aasan hain Bateriyan Peera Sun Arzan Aj Meeriya Peera
verses.en:
Exalted is your glory my master
That the storms are chased away (by your glory) my master
My longing for you is manifold O master — today, listen to what I have to say O master

verses.ar:
Nazar Karam Di Pavi Sayyan
Beriyan Banne Dhaavi Sayyan
Bhool Na Kidrey Jaawi Sayyan Laiyaan Tod Nibhaavi Sayyan
verses.en:
By attaining your guidance O master
My deserts have turned into fertile oasis
Don't forget me O master — honour my attachment to you O master
